dedupe_keys.name: lava renewable land availability analysis tool

description: LAVA calculates land available for utility-scale solar photovoltaic and onshore wind generation in a user-defined study region. Its developers publish a documented workflow that prepares spatial data, applies eligibility rules using atlite and derives suitable-area and renewable time-series outputs. Inputs include a regional boundary, land-cover and exclusion layers, weather or resource data and technology settings. Outputs are eligible land areas and resource profiles for the chosen grid or geography. Spatial and temporal detail follow the input layers and weather series. MIT-licensed source is public and the README gives Pixi installation guidance. A limitation is that it is research software with a limited user interface, and land eligibility rules reflect policy and data choices, not actual project consent. LAVA supports renewable siting and electricity capacity planning. The catalogue's model-pypsa can consume prepared resource assumptions after explicit conversion, but that interface was not checked. No spatial layer was downloaded.
name: LAVA renewable-land availability analysis tool
